summary: Implemented service identities with credential references (vault-style refs, hash-once tokens, idempotent create/rotate/disable/enable) and an append-only hash-chained immutable audit trail (seq + prev_hash + sha256 of canonical payload, verify detects modification/deletion/reordering). Verified with the worktree virtualenv: 127 pytest tests pass (89.09% coverage, threshold 60%), ruff format/check pass, mypy passes with no issues in 12 source files.

security_rights_budget_impact: Adds service identities with credential REFERENCES only (vault-style refs; raw secrets never stored), hash-once token pattern (raw token returned once, SHA-256 hash persisted), immediate rotation invalidation, idempotent disable/enable with audit events, and an append-only hash-chained audit ledger where tampering (modification, deletion, reordering) is detected by verify().
known_limitations: PostgreSQL persistence for service_identities and audit_events tables is deferred to CLIP-010.
The InMemoryAuditTrailStore holds events in a private list; the public interface is append-only by design (no update/delete/reverse/pop/clear).
